# Redesign landing page navigation bar component

## Description
This proposal refreshes the top navigation bar UI component across the website. The updated component
features responsive mobile hamburger toggles, account profile badges, dynamic network status indicators,
and theme toggle switches to improve overall usability and aesthetics.

## Requirements and context
- Update navigation items.
- Ensure responsive breakpoint collapse on mobile displays.

## Done when
- [ ] Navigation component refactored
- [ ] Theme toggle state persists in localStorage

## Suggested execution
1. Restyle navigation markup.
2. Verify accessibility.

## Guidelines with Complexity
Complexity: Medium
